description: An all-inclusive visual for Product Owners and SCRUM Teams to quickly see epics, features, and user stories in a traditional Kanban view. You can also use JVIZ Strategic Roadmap to display organizational goals, objectives, and initiatives. Whether you are a program manager, SCRUM master, Team Lead, or key stakeholder, JVIZ Strategic Roadmap provides a professional view into your goals and objectives. Key Features include: ● 𝗖𝘂𝘀𝘁𝗼𝗺 𝗦𝘁𝘆𝗹𝗶𝗻𝗴: Easy color picker and conditional formatting. ● 𝗠𝘂𝗹𝘁𝗶𝗽𝗹𝗲 𝗟𝗶𝘀𝘁 𝗕𝘂𝗰𝗸𝗲𝘁𝘀: Organize your cards into multiple columns. ● 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗶𝘇𝗮𝗯𝗹𝗲 𝗦𝘄𝗶𝗺𝗹𝗮𝗻𝗲𝘀: Adjust swimlane categories, size, and style. ● 𝗣𝗲𝗿𝗰𝗲𝗻𝘁 𝗖𝗼𝗺𝗽𝗹𝗲𝘁𝗲 𝗧𝗿𝗮𝗰𝗸𝗶𝗻𝗴: Quickly view work complete vs. remaining. ● 𝗖𝗮𝗿𝗱 𝗠𝗮𝗻𝗮𝗴𝗲𝗺𝗲𝗻𝘁: Task card styling can be easily customized. ● 𝗥𝗲𝘀𝗽𝗼𝗻𝘀𝗶𝘃𝗲 𝗗𝗲𝘀𝗶𝗴𝗻: Quickly adjust and resize the roadmap visual.
